summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything:** I did a read-only trace of the full watchlist path (client `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `server.ts` routing/CORS → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` session lookup → SQLite tables) and checked live data in `data/arca.db`. Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, I did **not** find a client-side or wiring bug:  - Every watchlist route filters by the authenticated `user_id`, with no default/fallback watchlist ID. - The client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request
